bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the agreement levels of human evaluators versus the MLLM-based evaluations to demonstrate how humans tend to inappropriately prioritize visual appeal over text-to-video alignment (semantic consistency), whereas the proposed model mitigates this bias.

Analyzing the drawbacks of traditional pairwise comparison evaluations (where human or LLM evaluators tend to favor the first item presented) and proposing a rating-based few-shot scoring paradigm to evaluate models without this order-preference bias.
